prompt: The camera advances steadily along the Mardi Himal Trail in Kaski, Nepal, capturing the serene yet challenging journey under a snowy night sky. The viewer's perspective moves forward, revealing a landscape blanketed in snow, with each step causing a gentle disturbance in the pristine white layer. Snowflakes continuously drift through the air, illuminated by an unseen light source that casts a soft glow, enhancing the visibility of the falling particles against the dark backdrop. The camera angle remains low, close to the ground, emphasizing the texture of the snow-covered terrain and the occasional rocky outcrop that emerges from beneath. As the camera progresses, the surrounding environment gradually reveals more details, including faint outlines of distant mountains shrouded in mist. The ambient lighting subtly shifts, creating a dynamic interplay of shadows and highlights across the undulating trail. The scene remains devoid of any human presence, reinforcing the sense of solitude and tranquility in this remote, natural setting. The continuous forward motion of the camera maintains a steady pace, allowing viewers to fully absorb the quiet beauty and isolation of the snowy night hike.
